summary: MaintProgramProfileInvoiceRates is a web user control for maintaining program invoice rates, handling the assignment and editing of invoice contacts, and managing invoice rate details for programs within the HSPnet application. Its interface enables administrators to add, edit, and delete invoice rates, associate contacts, and manage rate factors and conditions.
purpose: To allow authorized users to maintain program profile invoice rates, including setting rates, associating invoice contacts, and handling related workflow, validation, and business rules in an editable, interactive web interface.

workflows.name: Maintain Invoice Rates
steps: If UserSession exists and first load, populate invoice contact dropdown.
User selects or modifies invoice contact; updates email and phone display.
User can add, edit, or delete invoice rates via GridView (uxMaster) and FormView (uxDetail).
Add/Edit opens modal popup (mdlDetails) for invoice rate entry and editing.
On insert/update, values (ProgramID, PlacementTypeCodeID, StartDate, Rate, UnitCodeID, LedBySiteInstructor) are collected and validated.
Save triggers backend update, cache refresh, and redirect to current page.
Delete removes the invoice rate, refreshes session cache, and redirects.

workflows.name: Assign Invoice Contact
steps: Populate ddInvoiceContact with available contacts for the program.
Display selected contact's email and phone links.
On save, update the program's invoice contact in backend.

business_rules: Only users with a valid UserSession can edit or update information.
ScreenIsEditable determines if UI elements (dropdowns, save buttons) are enabled.
Invoice contacts must have valid email and phone information.
If no rows exist and ScreenIsEditable is true, show add button for 'no data found' state.
validations: Page.IsValid must be true before saving insert or update operations.
Rates parsed and validated as currency.
DropDown selections (PlacementType, Unit) must be valid and set.
Invoice contacts must have valid Staff ID.
calculations: Rate field parsed as decimal currency.
Factor field defaults to '1' on insert.
Currency symbol display depends on UserSession.UseAltLanguageFields.
conditions: UserSession presence required for selecting and updating data.
Show empty data panel when GridView has no rows and screen is editable.
UseSiteInstructor affects workflow and JavaScript variable setup.
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields bind to web controls for display and editing.
Modal dialogs (mdlDetails) used for add/edit operations.
ScriptManager and JavaScript injected for client-side field management.
Session cache refreshed after insert, update, delete, and contact assignment.
Redirects to current page after operations to maintain UI state.
Panel and button visibility managed based on conditions.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data operations (select/update/insert) are cancelled.
JavaScript errors prevented by custom add button logic for empty data.
content_gaps: Underlying database structure and entity relationships not fully described.
Some referenced utility and controller methods (Grid, Dropdown, StaffController) are not detailed.
No explicit UI layouts or data models provided.
